public_contracts.signature: SessionStart source=clear emits HANDOFF OFFER; startup/clear emit COMPACTION OFFER when no handoff offer
settings-baseline ### settings (autoCompactWindow: 300000) merged into target .claude/settings.json when absent; --missing emits settings<TAB>key: value
implementer batch result: status adds partial, optional resume_note

success_criteria.description: settings-baseline --json emits autoCompactWindow 300000 at top level; --missing lists it only when absent; --merge adds it when absent and keeps an engineer value
mtk-doctor baseline WARN names a missing baseline setting; --fix merges it; wording covers rules and settings

compact-archive.sh archives the summary with frontmatter at mode 0600, writes nothing on kill switch / empty summary / non-ignored .mtk, prunes >14d session dirs, exits 0 silently, stamps liveness; registered async PostCompact with timeout; classified rare
success_criteria.verification: bash tests/hooks/test-compact-archive.sh && bash tests/hooks/test-hook-registry.sh && bash tests/hooks/test-hooks-wiring.sh

success_criteria.description: session-start emits HANDOFF OFFER on clear as on startup; emits one COMPACTION OFFER for the newest same-branch summary within 24h when no handoff offer; compact source unchanged

implementer prompt has the MTK_IMPLEMENTER_MAX_CALLS budget rule, partial status with resume_note and the result-size cap; subagent-implementation and dynamic-workflow respawn partial via RESUME at most twice then halt; env-knobs documents both knobs
